_comment: Your live ad inventory. Set sold:true and fill the fields to run a campaign. Unsold slots automatically render a 'your ad here' house ad pointing at /advertise — which is how you sell the next one.

sidebar._note: Set sold:true to run this. With house:true it renders as 'From the publisher' and the rate card still shows the slot as available, since self-promotion is not a sale. Currently off: an empty slot that recruits advertisers is worth more than one reaching the wrong audience.
